metadata.description: Keep your AI coding agents on track and in context. Guardrails for Claude Code that hold the agent to your rules, ask before risky commands run, notice when it loops, and check its code for security and privacy problems. Runs locally; an optional workspace needs an API key.

plugins.name: lintsure
plugins.description: Guards each edit and command your agent makes, and checks its code with 85 rules mapped to the OWASP Top 10, OWASP LLM Top 10, CWE Top 25, GDPR, the EU AI Act and the EU CRA. Runs locally; nothing is sent unless you add an API key.
